title: Core Quintet #44
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 5:4 aspect ratio, five women in a single row.

A photograph of FIVE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 5 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Far-left woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her early 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, luminous glossy skin with a bright highlighter, thick black eyeliner, extremely long dramatic false lashes top and bottom, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy peach-pink lips, a confident sparkling expression, cool and composed, soft champagne-blonde hair styled in sleek straight, real living eyes. Long round nails, glittery finish.

Far-left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large and statuesque woman, far beyond any real person. A powerful, commanding build carrying great natural size throughout: broad strong shoulders, a full heavy bust, a thick sturdy torso with only a soft, gentle waistline, and enormous broad hips and thighs beneath it, every curve large, solid and continuous rather than sharply cinched anywhere. Thick strong arms, a full round face with a warm, regal bearing. Her head stays in correct proportion to her broad frame. Solid and continuous rather than dramatically contoured. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Far-left woman's body art: painted in French Limoges enamel — a deep cobalt-blue ground with fine white and gold grisaille scrollwork, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense grisaille scrollwork filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Far-left woman's pose: caught mid-jump, feet off the ground.

Far-left woman's footwear: extreme gold plain stiletto pumps, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Left woman: a real adult American woman in her early 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, sun-kissed skin, heavily sculpted contour and a strong highlighter on the cheekbones, bold defined brows, long fluffy false lashes, shimmery bronze eyeshadow, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy nude lips with a defined lip-liner outline, a confident, camera-ready smile, sultry, vivid copper-orange hair styled in a short pixie cut, real living eyes. Long oval nails, chrome finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: painted in Ukrainian Petrykivka floral painting — a black ground with bright red, orange and gold folk-art flowers, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense folk-art florals filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Left woman's pose: mid-stride walking toward camera.

Left woman's footwear: extreme gold extreme platform clear heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Center woman: a real adult Chinese woman in her mid 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, fair matte skin with a soft powdery finish, thin sharply arched brows, soft brown and rose eyeshadow, a fine black liner with a small flick, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong rose-red blush on the apples of the cheeks, deep glossy red lips with a defined edge, a poised, glamorous expression, cheerful, dark roots fading smoothly into sun-kissed lighter ends (balayage) hair styled in a chin-length bob, real living eyes. Long round nails, holographic finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: painted in Moroccan zellige tile mosaic — a deep cobalt ground with interlocking white, terracotta and gold motifs, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense interlocking star-and-cross motifs filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Center woman's pose: leaning one arm on a window frame.

Center woman's footwear: extreme gold platform stiletto Mary Janes, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Right woman: a real adult Uzbek woman in her late 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, a jewelled brow ornament, deep red lips, warm olive skin, a regal composed expression, bold and confident, deep burgundy wine-red hair styled in a mohawk with volume along the centre of the scalp, real living eyes. Long oval nails, glossy finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large and statuesque woman, far beyond any real person. A powerful, commanding build carrying great natural size throughout: broad strong shoulders, a full heavy bust, a thick sturdy torso with only a soft, gentle waistline, and enormous broad hips and thighs beneath it, every curve large, solid and continuous rather than sharply cinched anywhere. Thick strong arms, a full round face with a warm, regal bearing. Her head stays in correct proportion to her broad frame. Solid and continuous rather than dramatically contoured. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: painted in Japanese Kutani porcelain — a cream-white ground with bold red, gold and green overglaze enamels, wide gold-and-red bands following every deep crease, dense overglaze florals filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Right woman's pose: leaning one arm on a window frame.

Right woman's footwear: extreme gold-and-red platform stiletto pumps, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Far-right woman: a real adult French woman in her early 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, fair natural skin with a light dewy finish, softly brushed natural brows, a barely-there brown liner and fluttering lashes, no eyeshadow, soft natural colour on the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a single bold classic red lip with a soft matte finish, an unbothered, effortless expression, cool and composed, soft pastel-pink hair styled in a low chignon knot at the nape, real living eyes. Long oval nails, matte finish.

Far-right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her hips and rear so wide. A dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist sits above hips and a rear so massively rounded and projecting that they dominate her entire silhouette from every angle — the rear itself curving outward and upward in a high, rounded, gravity-defying shape. A full round bust above the cinched waist, gigantic thick thighs meeting the rear's curve, thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Far-right woman's body art: painted in Croatian Hvar filigree-inspired linework — an ivory ground with fine cream and gold painted filigree linework, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense fine filigree linework filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Far-right woman's pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out.

Far-right woman's footwear: extreme gold extreme platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly.

Skin (all): real photographic skin, visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, no illustration finish, no CG sheen.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 5, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 5:4 landscape 8K.
